decisions.reason: As a publicly presented flagship tied to the firm's circular low-emission strategy, the bio-based binder benefits from rising sunk commitment and reputational justification, so management is inclined to keep it despite its somewhat looser fit with the core machinery business.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is both close to the firm's established technological base and highly visible in its strategic communication, so accumulated investment and commitment make withdrawal within the next year unlikely.
